name: Tom Sawyer SysML v2 Viewer
description: A deployable viewer that connects to SysML v2 API-compliant repositories and automatically lays out interactive graph visualizations for model exploration and presentation.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. It is intentionally classified as a viewer, not a model editor.

sysmlV2Api.note: Connects to repositories implementing the OMG Systems Modeling API and Services specification.

classificationNotes: The viewer does not author or edit SysML v2 model content.
It can be deployed on premises or in AWS and is also offered for OEM embedding.
